name: Tracking Confession

parameters.responseBody: ={ "ok": true, "message": "Tracking confession saved to Vault: {{ $('Format Vault Note').item.json.fileName }}" }

notes:
Phase 4 — Tracking Confession pipeline.

Formats agent input as a dated Obsidian note and writes it to 00-Inbox/notes/ via the obsidian-livesync-mcp REST API.

Setup:
1. Import this workflow in n8n.
2. Set OBSIDIAN_MCP_URL and OBSIDIAN_MCP_API_KEY environment variables in n8n
   (same values as MCP_OBSIDIAN_URL / MCP_OBSIDIAN_API_KEY in the app's .env).
3. Activate the workflow.
4. The MCP trigger path is 'tracking-confession'.

Agent call example:
  Tool: n8n__tracking_confession
  Args: {
    "confession": "Today I spent 3 hours on YouTube instead of coding.",
    "date": "2026-09-22",
    "tags": ["tracking", "distraction"]
  }
